entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ( BY SHRI DILIP PARIHAR- PANEL LAWYER)

This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking following reliefs:
"It is most humbly and respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be graciously pleased to- Quash first information report No. 016 dated 24- 04-2023 under section 498A & 34 of IPC read with section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act (Annexure-A-1) by Respondent police against Applicant and proceeding thereto against the Applicant and pass such further or other order or orders in favor of Applicant and against Non- Applicant as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case along with cost of petition"
